    int d[MAXV], ptr[MAXV];

    void addEdge(int v, int u, int cap) {
        g[v].push_back(Edge(u, cap, 0, 0));
        g[u].push_back(Edge(v, 0, 0, 0));
        g[v].back().rev = (int)g[u].size() - 1;
        g[u].back().rev = (int)g[v].size() - 1;
    }

        for (int i = 0; i <= t; ++i) d[i] = INF;
        queue<int> q;
        d[s] = 0;
        q.push(s);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int v = q.front(); q.pop();
            for (size_t i = 0; i < g[v].size(); ++i) {
                const Edge &e = g[v][i];
                if (d[e.to] == INF && e.c > e.f) {
                    d[e.to] = d[v] + 1;
                    q.push(e.to);

        }

        if (v == t) return curFlow;

            int cf = e.c - e.f;

                }

        }
        return flow;
    }
